messages:
lina: running the js onboarding sample with prefetch=4 and concurrency=8, seeing intermittent duplicate pages and 429s. looks like retries after auth refresh are replaying stale cursor payloads.

jon: can you paste a tiny log snippet? is this specific to the sampleapp or the SDK too?

lina: snippet from local run:
```
INFO fetch cursor=curA -> items=30
WARN got 401 -> token refresh started
INFO token refreshed
INFO retry request body(cursor=curA) -> 429
INFO fetch cursor=curB -> items=30
INFO fetch cursor=curA -> items=30  // duplicate page
```

lina: this reproduces reliably when prefetch > concurrency and we trigger an auth refresh mid-prefetch.

emma: likely the HTTP client is replaying the raw request body after refresh. if the body contained cursor snapshot, replay will fetch an old page. python sdk has a cursor_guard; js doesn't.

emma: short-term workaround: set prefetch=1 or serialize inflight per-cursor. longer term: retry handler should consult current paginator state before re-sending.

zeke: parity note: go and cs teams also saw similar behavior. we should standardize API: propose `shouldReplayRequest(oldReq, currentPaginatorState) -> boolean` for all sdks. paginator can opt-in to veto replays when cursors diverge.

jon: agree. default for generic requests stays as-is, but paginators should default to not replaying when request.body.cursor != state.latestCursor(streamId). also emit metric `paginator.retry_dropped`.

emma: alternative lighter fix is per-cursor semaphore in the sampleapp; quick and effective but noisy. prefer sdk-level retry guard + docs note for onboarding sampleapp.

lina: i'll open a PR with `retryGuard` for the paginator, add a short repro harness that simulates 401+retry mid-prefetch, and update the sampleapp docs to recommend prefetch <= concurrency until the change ships.

devex-bot: Created issue #6124: "js-sdk: prefetch replay after auth refresh causes duplicate pages"

ci-bot: Staging preview for lina/prefetch-retry-guard available at https://staging.internal.redwood/sampleapp/branch/lina-prefetch-fix

jon: add an e2e that injects 401s during prefetch and asserts no duplicates. include changelog note (minor bump) if default retry semantics change.

lina: will do. pinging @emma and @zeke for parity review on the API shape. thanks :thumbsup:
